meta.source: oNe More Reason.pdf — Sportlab Groningen campagne toolkit 2026 (printed at 50%: 1pt = 2px)

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Near-black of the gym world. Dark panels, haakje tiles, story/feed backgrounds; headline and wordmark ink on light grounds.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Warm dark brown-black. Top of the dark panel gradient and raised dark surfaces.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm sand. The 'De belofte' box, light stickers, secondary button on dark, and the highlighted second line of a quote on dark (e.g. 'JUST ONE MORE REASON TO START.').

tokens.name: warm-white
tokens.usage: Warm white. Light sticker fills; the lightest brand surface.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: CTA orange — ONLY on action buttons (with `on-cta` ink label) and text links on dark ('Plan je gratis proefles', 'Doe mee', 'Let’s talk goals →'). Never as a fill, block, background or decoration. As link text: 6.96:1 on ink, 4.68:1 on panel-glow. Not for text on light grounds (2.6:1). Exception: the TV dashboard uses the orange family (orange-200/300/700 and the ember glows) for details. There, the solid cta fill is kept for the one action (timer start/pause) and the main block.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Sub-campaign accent, quiet. Use sparingly; never for CTAs. White text on it 7.71:1.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Sub-campaign accent, quiet. Use sparingly; never for CTAs. White text on it 6.55:1.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Headlines, haakjes and the wordmark on dark panels and photography.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light: the toolkit's warm grey page; dark: ink.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Light cards and info panels on the page ground (co-branding, colour rule, type specimens, light button panel).

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Dark campaign panels and tiles that sit on the page (kapstok card, haakje tiles, dark button panel).

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The opposite of the page ground: a solid block that always contrasts with surface-page.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, wordmark and Anton display on surface-page and surface-card (13.3:1 / 16.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy on surface-page and surface-card (8.5:1 light; 8.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Section intros, captions, small supporting text. Light 4.63:1 on surface-page, 5.54:1 on surface-card; dark 5.28:1 on surface-page, 4.63:1 on surface-card. (Darkened from the toolkit's #6F6A60 / #8A7E6E to pass WCAG AA.)

tokens.name: text-eyebrow
tokens.usage: Spaced-caps eyebrow labels ('DE HAAKJES', 'A — STACKED POSTER'). Light 4.63:1 on surface-page, 5.54:1 on surface-card; dark 14.3:1. (Darkened from the toolkit's #8A8479 to pass WCAG AA.)

tokens.name: text-on-panel
tokens.usage: Headlines and haakjes on ink/charcoal panels and photo overlays (16.5:1+).

tokens.name: text-on-panel-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy on dark panels ('Voor wie al langer wil beginnen…'): 8.9:1 on ink, 6.0:1 on panel-glow.

tokens.name: text-on-panel-eyebrow
tokens.usage: Small kickers on dark panels and gradients ('ONE MORE REASON' above a haakje, panel labels, footers). 6.88:1 on ink, 6.03:1 on charcoal, 4.63:1 on the brightest panel-glow spot. (Lightened from the toolkit's #8A7E6E to pass WCAG AA everywhere on dark.)

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dashed section rules, outlined tags on light. Decorative (1.3:1) — not for control borders.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Border of form controls (inputs) and the dashed outline of empty stat tiles in the member area. 4.18:1 on warm-white, 3.8:1 on surface-card: meets the 3:1 rule for control borders, which line (decorative, 1.3:1) does not.

tokens.name: line-panel
tokens.usage: Hairlines and block outlines on dark panels in the member area (workout blocks in 'Volgende les'). Decorative only (1.7:1 on charcoal); never the only cue.

tokens.name: on-cta
tokens.usage: Label on a CTA-orange button: ink, 6.96:1 (WCAG AA). Replaces the toolkit's white label, which was only 2.7:1. Never put white text on cta.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline (addition — the toolkit shows none): 2px solid, 2px offset. 13.3:1 on the light page, 15.8:1 on ink.

tokens.name: panel-glow
tokens.usage: Sampled: the warm light spot (top-right) in the radial gradient of dark panels and stories.

tokens.name: panel-deep
tokens.usage: Sampled: the bottom of the dark panel gradient.

tokens.name: steel-glow
tokens.usage: Sampled: the cool light spot in the 'manifesto' story/carousel gradient (steel sub-tone).

tokens.name: steel-deep
tokens.usage: Sampled: the bottom of the cool manifesto gradient.

tokens.name: orange-200
tokens.usage: TV only: light orange tint (peach). Text accents and pill fill with ink text (11.8:1). 10.4:1 on charcoal.

tokens.name: orange-300
tokens.usage: TV only: mid orange tint. Block numbers, labels, top bars, progress bar end, the 'next' outline. 9.4:1 on ink, 8.2:1 on charcoal.

tokens.name: orange-700
tokens.usage: TV only: deep orange shade. Pill fill with white text (7.5:1), e.g. the 'Open' status and duration pills.

tokens.name: tv-glow-ember
tokens.usage: TV background: the orange-brown glow (top-left of screens and modals). Keeps text-on-panel-eyebrow at 5.1:1, white at 14:1.

tokens.name: tv-glow-ember-deep
tokens.usage: TV background: the deeper ember glow (bottom-right). Keeps text-on-panel-eyebrow at 5.7:1.

tokens.name: line-tv
tokens.usage: TV dashboard dividers, progress-bar track and modal edge on ink/charcoal (1.9:1 on ink — decorative; content is never told apart by this line alone).

color.note: All text/background pairs named in usage notes meet WCAG 2 AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large). Brand hues (ink, sand, cta, steel, olive) are unchanged; only text greys and the CTA label were adjusted.

groups.name: Display — Anton
groups.note: Gritty caps for power: campaign identity, the kapstok and every haakje. Always UPPERCASE, letter-spacing 0. Google Fonts: Anton 400.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Toolkit/poster masthead, stacked poster lockup.

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: ONE MORE REASON TO KEEP GOING.
styles.usage: Story and feed headlines; specimen size.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Kapstok + haakje inside cards.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Haakje tiles.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: YOU DO NOT NEED A PERFECT REASON.
styles.usage: Pull quotes / campaign line.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Haakje chips and label stickers.

groups.name: Warm — Poppins
groups.note: Warm, rounded: the human side. Headings in 700, body in 400, buttons in 600. Sentence case. Google Fonts: Poppins 400/600/700.

styles.name: heading-warm
styles.usage: Warm headings in stories, carousel and personal-training posts.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Geen losse campagne, maar de kapstok van Sportlab.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs.

styles.name: promise
styles.sample: Geef jezelf een jaar waarin je sterker wordt dan je dacht.
styles.usage: 'De belofte' box.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 1-op-1 trainen met een persoonlijk plan, in een gym met een ongedwongen sfeer.
styles.usage: Explanations, captions, long copy.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Pill buttons and text links.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Voor wie al langer wil beginnen maar blijft uitstellen.
styles.usage: Supporting copy in cards.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions, notes.

groups.name: Label — Archivo
groups.note: Tight wordmark font for the SPORTLAB wordmark, eyebrows and labels. Spaced caps. Google Fonts: Archivo 600/700/800.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The SPORTLAB wordmark (also at 15px in story/feed headers, 18px in co-branding).

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings in toolkits and docs.

styles.name: section-number
styles.usage: Number before a section title.

styles.name: haakjes-line
styles.sample: TO START · TO KEEP GOING · TO GET STRONG
styles.usage: Inline list of haakjes, separated by ·.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tag pills, card kickers (uppercase).

styles.name: eyebrow-s
styles.usage: Micro kickers inside dark cards and outlined tags.

groups.name: TV — 10-foot
groups.note: Gym TV dashboard at 1920×1080, read from 3–8 m. Nothing below 24px; body 34px. Always on the dark ground (ink/charcoal) with text-on-panel colours.

styles.name: tv-timer
styles.usage: Block timer countdown (tabular numerals).

styles.name: tv-title
styles.usage: Screen title: the date, the workout name.

styles.name: tv-time
styles.usage: Class start time in the schedule.

styles.name: tv-heading
styles.usage: Class name in schedule rows; clock.

styles.name: tv-block-title
styles.usage: Workout block titles.

styles.name: tv-exercise
styles.usage: Exercise lines in a block (28px/36px in the compact 5-block layout).

styles.name: tv-body
styles.usage: Supporting copy, reps/sets, meta lines.

styles.name: tv-cue
styles.usage: Coaching cues under an exercise; the smallest TV text (24px minimum).

styles.name: tv-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and duration tags on TV.

groups.name: Web — blog
groups.note: Website reading sizes (the campaign scale is print-derived and too small for long reads). Desktop values; on mobile (<768px) step display/h1 down as noted. Light grounds: surface-page / surface-card with text-* tokens.

styles.name: web-display
styles.sample: ONE MORE REASON TO KEEP GOING
styles.usage: English campaign line in a blog hero (Anton, uppercase). Mobile 56px.

styles.name: web-h1
styles.sample: Je hoeft niet fit te zijn om te beginnen
styles.usage: Article title (Dutch, Poppins 700). Mobile 34px/40px.

styles.name: web-h2
styles.usage: Section headings inside an article; featured card title. Mobile 26px/32px.

styles.name: web-h3
styles.usage: Post-card titles, sub-headings.

styles.name: web-lead
styles.sample: Misschien wacht je op het perfecte moment.
styles.usage: Article intro and hero intro. Mobile 18px/30px.

styles.name: web-body
styles.sample: Sterker worden begint niet met perfect zijn. Het begint met opkomen dagen.
styles.usage: Article body; max line length web-measure.

styles.name: web-small
styles.usage: Card excerpts, captions, meta lines.

styles.name: web-meta
styles.usage: Category · date · reading time eyebrows (uppercase).

styles.name: web-pull
styles.sample: YOU DO NOT NEED A PERFECT REASON.
styles.usage: Pull quote inside an article (English campaign line). Mobile 30px.

groups.name: App — ledenomgeving
groups.note: Member area (login, Overzicht) on web and in the React Native app. Desktop values; on phones (the app, and the website below 768px) use the phone value in each usage. Light grounds with text-* tokens; the 'Volgende les' panel is .sl-dark.

styles.name: app-h1
styles.usage: Greeting at the top of Overzicht, and the login heading. Dutch, sentence case, ends in a full stop. Phone 28px/34px.

styles.name: app-h2
styles.usage: Section and card titles. Phone 20px/26px.

styles.name: app-panel-title
styles.usage: Lesson title in the 'Volgende les' panel, white on .sl-dark. Phone 22px/28px.

styles.name: app-time
styles.usage: Start time of the next lesson (Anton, tabular). Numbers only. Phone 72px.

styles.name: app-number
styles.usage: Measurements, program week ('05'), event day ('08'), lesson date ('21', 34px). Anton for numbers only, never for Dutch words. Phone 28px.

styles.name: app-row-title
styles.usage: Lesson, event and logbook row titles. Phone 15px/22px.

styles.name: app-meta
styles.usage: Row meta and card subtitles in text-muted. Phone 13px/18px.

styles.name: app-input
styles.usage: Text in form fields. Never below 16px, so iOS doesn't zoom in on focus.

styles.name: app-tag
styles.usage: Status tags (Ingeschreven, Wachtlijst · 2e, event type), spaced caps. Phone 9px.

styles.name: app-tab
styles.usage: Tab bar labels. In the app the native tab bar draws these in the system font; we only choose the words and the tint.

spacing.note: Measured from the toolkit (pt × 2). Not a strict grid — keep these exact values.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between haakje chips and between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles in a row (haakje tiles, swatches).

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Inner padding of small haakje tiles and pill-button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Inner padding of dark campaign cards and feed/story safe area.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Gap between two large cards / columns.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Inner padding of large panels (type specimens, button panels).

tokens.name: space-60
tokens.usage: Page inset of a toolkit/document page.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: tv-safe-x
tokens.usage: TV horizontal safe area (5% of 1920) — nothing important outside it.

tokens.name: tv-safe-y
tokens.usage: TV vertical safe area (≈6% of 1080).

tokens.name: tv-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between TV cards, columns and schedule rows.

tokens.name: web-container
tokens.usage: Max width of website content (header, grids, footer).

tokens.name: web-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of article text (≈70 characters at web-body).

tokens.name: web-gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding on mobile; gap between blog cards.

tokens.name: app-container
tokens.usage: Max width of the member area's header and content on web.

tokens.name: app-gutter
tokens.usage: Side padding of the member area on phones and inside the web container.

radius.note: Soft corners on cards, pills for buttons and tags.

tokens.name: radius-sticker
tokens.usage: Rectangular label stickers ('… TO GET STRONG').

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Haakje chips.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, panels, swatches, social templates.

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: Square 'rep counter' sticker (+1).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tag pills, eyebrow pills, dot-pill sticker.

tokens.name: radius-tv
tokens.usage: Cards and modal on the TV dashboard (radius-card doubled for the 10-foot scale).
